name: FakeProfileThemes
description: Allows profile theming by hiding the colors in your bio thanks to invisible 3y3 encoding
summary: Profile theme colours hidden in bios, shown on profiles; pick yours and copy the invisible text

settings.label: Default color source if both are present
settings.description: Default color source if both are present

settings.label: Copy 3y3
settings.description: Copies the invisible text for these colours; paste it anywhere in your bio (in Discord's profile settings).

settings.label: Preview
settings.description: Opens your profile with these colours (for a minute; only you see it).

notes: Like upstream, a bio holding "[#rrggbb,#rrggbb]" as invisible Unicode tag characters (3y3) shows that profile with those theme colours: the popup in a gradient from the primary to the accent colour, the banner in the primary one when it has no image or colour of its own. With "Nitro colors" first, a profile's own Nitro theme wins. The settings page has upstream's colour pickers and "Copy 3y3", which copies the invisible text to paste into your bio; its preview is "Preview", which opens your profile with the picked colours for a minute. Qord itself now shows Nitro profile themes (theme_colors), which it didn't before, and leaves the tag characters out of shown bios, as Discord does. Upstream's "Copy 3y3" button in Discord's own profile editor has no counterpart: Qord has no profile editor, so the bio is edited in Discord.
